title: Missing Beat · Pair relay
hook: Find a game, gather your friends and start playing.

knows: The group wants an activity to play together.
doesNotKnow: The setup, turn and ending for this house-rule format.

misconception: The group has to know a complicated rulebook before starting.
objective: Learn how to play Missing Beat · Pair relay with friends.

claims.text: Original house rules: Agree on a four-beat clap pattern with one silent beat. A partner performs the pattern once; the lead identifies the silent beat by number. The identified beat matches the agreed silent beat. Form pairs. On each pair’s turn, both people make separate attempts with fresh challenges, helping only their partner. The pair earns one point only if both succeed. Each pair has two turns. Highest score wins.
claims.source: Original playable house-rule proposal; not an authoritative ruleset for a traditional game.

claims.text: For this version: 4, 6 or 8 players; materials: None.
claims.source: Proposed setup and player range for this activity.

recall.question: In Missing Beat, what counts as a successful turn?
options: The group ends the round before anyone plays.
The identified beat matches the agreed silent beat.
The lead skips the turn without attempting it.
recall.why: The identified beat matches the agreed silent beat.
